correctness.rationale: The mapping torus N of f(x,y)=(y,-x) is smooth closed connected and nonorientable. In H² of the fiber, the integral monodromy A=[[0,-1],[1,0]] has (A-I) determinant 2, zero kernel and cokernel Z/2. Its degree-four monodromy is -1. Integral Wang then yields H²(N,Z)=H⁴(N,Z)=0, H³(N,Z)=H⁵(N,Z)=Z/2. Mod2 invariants in H²(F,Z/2) are generated by u+v, defining xi with alpha=beta2(xi) nonzero period two. In degree four mod4 the invariant fiber subgroup is {0,2uv}; P_2(xi)|F=2uv is its nonzero element, so injectivity of beta4 (H⁴(N,Z)=0) makes beta4 P_2(xi) a nonzero H⁵(N,Z) class. Since alpha cup H²(N,Z)=0, Antieau-Williams Theorem A yields ind(alpha)=2*2=4. Becerra-Lupercio Theorem 7.5 and stable-to-actual realization give regular rank 2 ind=8. Rank2 trivial case and rank4 via their 3-dimensional gerbe ×S² complete possibilities. Independent exact Smith/mod2/mod4 computations reproduced these input relations, not topological theorems themselves.
